scope: Wip.Factory v0.4 engineering hardening; independent product acceptance excluded

requirements.requirement: Enforce exactly one ASP.NET Core web application.
requirements.notes: The check fails unless the classified web-application count is exactly one.

requirements.requirement: Classify projects using structural MSBuild semantics, not filenames or arbitrary text matches.
requirements.notes: Classification uses the project SDK, OutputType, IsTestProject, test-provider PackageReference, FrameworkReference and entry-point evidence.

requirements.requirement: Allow legitimate library and test projects.
requirements.notes: xUnit v3/MSTest executable test projects without a user entry point are accepted; ASP.NET Core libraries are accepted.

requirements.requirement: Prevent executable projects disguised as tests from bypassing architecture enforcement.
requirements.notes: A *.Tests filename is not a test marker; a test-declared executable with Program.cs/StartupObject is a named disguised-executable refusal.

requirements.requirement: Reject unsupported, malformed, or ambiguous project layouts.
requirements.notes: Unknown SDKs, non-SDK projects, conditional classification, inherited overrides and explicit imports fail the project-layout-supported check.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the existing accepted application structure.
requirements.notes: The accepted Web SDK + Program.cs shape and a separate test project still pass.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the original target commit across worktree retries.
requirements.notes: The original target is persisted in the repository Git directory and reused; TargetHasAdvanced reports the observed drift without rebasing.

requirements.requirement: Make worktree provisioning idempotent.
requirements.notes: A per-session cross-process lease serializes create/attach; a valid existing worktree is reused.

requirements.requirement: Preserve valid uncommitted implementation work.
requirements.notes: Retries never reset, clean or rebase the worktree; untracked and modified files survive.

requirements.requirement: Persist original failure causes and subsequent retry failures separately.
requirements.notes: Attempts are append-only; the original failure keeps role=original and later failures role=retry with PreviousAttemptId.

requirements.requirement: Handle partial worktrees, orphaned branches, process termination, and concurrent retries.
requirements.notes: Missing registrations are pruned/repaired; a partial directory is preserved and refused rather than deleted; the process-death lease is an OS file handle.

requirements.requirement: Reject mismatched or corrupted worktrees.
requirements.notes: Branch, worktree path, repository, session and schema identity are checked; corrupt state fails closed.

requirements.requirement: Prevent silent rebasing or baseline substitution when the target branch advances.
requirements.notes: Recorded heads must remain ancestors; an orphan branch without prior state uses an explicitly labelled inferred merge-base.

requirements.requirement: Introduce a consistent, version-bound engineering delivery record.
requirements.notes: Schema factory/engineering-delivery@1; content-addressed digest; generated only by the product CLI.

requirements.requirement: Distinguish build/test success from independent product acceptance.
requirements.notes: Engineering status is derived from build/tests/gates; acceptance is a separate historical axis and cannot be a mandatory engineering gate.

requirements.requirement: Derive engineering status from executed tests and durable evidence.
requirements.notes: ENGINEERING_COMPLETE requires a passing build, zero failures and every mandatory gate green.

requirements.requirement: Eliminate contradictory implementation metrics across reports.
requirements.notes: Suite counts must partition; blocked/complete must match the facts; the gate report and record are generated from the same measured TRX files.

requirements.requirement: Track actual test counts, revisions, build digests, and known limitations.
requirements.notes: Per-suite executed/passed/failed/skipped counts, TRX digests, revision, build digest and limitations are mandatory.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the historical outcome of the original failed independent acceptance.
requirements.notes: PA-01 fail, PA-02 pass and pair fail are recorded with the evidence digest; the record is historical, not a new verdict.

requirements.requirement: Do not turn historical remediation evidence into a new acceptance verdict; engineering completion must not depend on acceptance certification.
requirements.notes: Acceptance gate ids are refused as mandatory; ACCEPTED and PRODUCTION_READY are refused statuses.

requirements.requirement: Bound active working-context growth.
requirements.notes: The instrument emits a bounded per-turn working view and a context pack; DSH compaction remains the live enforcement mechanism.

requirements.requirement: Separate historical evidence from active context and reconstruct context from durable state.
requirements.notes: Per-turn facts and seq locators are separated from the full archive; work-state rebuilds effective status from durable stores.

requirements.requirement: Retrieve detailed evidence on demand and preserve provenance across context compression.
requirements.notes: Spill locators/output views hold full detail; the projection records source and projection digests.

requirements.requirement: Instrument token usage, cache utilization, model calls, retries, tool calls, wall time, and cost where available.
evidence: scripts/session-budget.spec.ts#reports unknown cost when a response has no complete usage measurement
requirements.notes: Absent usage is unknown/null, never zero; cost uses pinned public DeepSeek Flash rates.

requirements.requirement: Detect repetitive or stalled execution loops.
evidence: scripts/session-budget.spec.ts#detects a repeated tool-call group and a stalled turn
requirements.notes: The live guard injects a bounded reminder; the offline instrument reports repeated-call groups and failed-repeat stalled turns.

requirements.requirement: Benchmark against a reproducible baseline.
requirements.notes: The frozen prior-session archive (SHA-256 93d0249a…) reproduces one command: 515 model calls, 586 tool calls, 217,628,655 aggregate tokens, $1.4273.

requirements.requirement: Multiple web applications are rejected; disguised executables are rejected; valid libraries and tests are allowed.
requirements.notes: Executed in the split architecture conformance suite.

requirements.requirement: Worktree retry preserves its original baseline; concurrent retries produce consistent state; original failure causes survive recovery.
requirements.notes: Concurrency is serialized by an in-process gate plus an OS file lease.

requirements.requirement: Merge recovery and post-merge verification remain correct; stale evidence cannot authorize operations.
requirements.notes: These are existing executed v0.4 gates; the engineering gate runner re-runs the host suite and records the TRX digest.

requirements.requirement: DSH refuses goal completion when required engineering deliverables are missing.
evidence: scripts/engineering-deliverables-gate.spec.ts#blocks goal completion through the real goal service and commits nothing
requirements.notes: The check is registered on the real GoalService; missing/empty/malformed/escaping/status-mismatched artifacts yield a blocked completion and no goal/change commit.

requirements.requirement: Delegation respects agent capabilities.
requirements.notes: Mount-time and request-time refusals cover agentOptions, agentPreset, depthLimit, outputSchema and the session model route.
